ييراق (form XI)
# يَيْرَاقُّ (yayrāqqu) /jaj.raːq.qu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِيرَاقَّ (īrāqqa)
# يَيْرَاقَّ (yayrāqqa) /jaj.raːq.qa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِيرَاقَّ (īrāqqa)
# يَيْرَاقِّ (yayrāqqi) /jaj.raːq.qi/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِيرَاقَّ (īrāqqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
